item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 09:00 AM 20 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(Buhi, IrigaCity, Baao, Pasacao, SanFernando, Minalabac, Bula, Nabua, Balatan, Bato), #Albay, #Sorsogon(PrietoDiaz, Gubat, Barcelona, Bulusan, CityOfSorsogon, SantaMagdalena), #NorthernSamar(Victoria, SanIsidro, LopeDeVega, SilvinoLobos, Laoang, Palapag, Catubig, Mapanas, Gamay, Lapinig, LasNavas), #Catanduanes(SanMiguel, Baras, Gigmoto, Viga, Bagamanoc, Panganiban, Virac and Bato) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte, #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Sipocot, Cabusao, Calabanga, Lupi, Lagonoy, Goa, Bombon, Magarao, Canaman, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Presentacion, SanJose, NagaCity, Camaligan, Libmanan, Pamplona, Gainza, Milaor, DelGallego, Ragay, Tigaon, Sagñay, Ocampo, Pili), #NorthernSamar(Catarman, Mondragon, SanRoque, Bobon, SanJose, Rosario, Biri, Lavezares, Allen, Pambujan), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres and Pandan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
